description: Dedicated wiki index for the Chronicles of the Elemental Realms source. This section is independent from Kaysender and Solanum Umbra and contains Hypertext d20 creature references organized by planar and ecological category, including planar leeches, parasites, symbiotes, their hosts, prey, breeding grounds, and feeding-ground ecologies.

categories.name: Leech Hosts, Prey, and Feeding Grounds

leechCatalogPolicy.definition: Any creature whose primary sustenance is obtained by feeding upon another creature, regardless of whether the relationship is parasitic, symbiotic, or facultative.
leechCatalogPolicy.classificationModel: Relational and topological rather than strictly anatomical.
leechCatalogPolicy.flameMultiplicityMinimum: Flame-aligned leech varieties must remain at least twice as numerous as the largest non-flame planar grouping in this catalogue pass.

hostEcologyPolicy.relationshipIntegrity: Every host entry must identify at least one registered leech and every registered leech must be represented by at least one host relationship.
